author: self
question: Export every order line with customer details as a spreadsheet.
sql:
WITH top_cities AS (
  SELECT
    a.city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS city_orders
  FROM sales AS s
  LEFT JOIN customer_addresses AS a
    ON s.address_id = a.address_id
  WHERE
    s.line_type = 'Sale'
    AND s.placed_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND s.placed_at < CAST('2026-11-15' AS TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY
    a.city
  ORDER BY
    city_orders DESC,
    a.city ASC
  LIMIT 25
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(a.city, 'Unknown') AS delivery_city,
  CASE
    WHEN s.is_first_order IS TRUE
    THEN 'New'
    WHEN s.is_first_order IS FALSE
    THEN 'Repeat'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS customer_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS orders
FROM sales AS s
LEFT JOIN customer_addresses AS a
  ON s.address_id = a.address_id
JOIN top_cities AS t
  ON a.city IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.city
WHERE
  s.line_type = 'Sale'
  AND s.placed_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND s.placed_at < CAST('2026-11-15' AS TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY
  a.city,
  customer_type,
  t.city_orders
ORDER BY
  t.city_orders DESC,
  a.city ASC,
  customer_type
LIMIT 50

author: self
question: Show me the mobile app conversion rate by month in 2026.
sql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', c.event_at) AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.event_type = 'purchase' THEN c.session_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.session_id), 0) AS conversion_rate,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.session_id) AS sessions
FROM clickstream AS c
WHERE
  c.event_at >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND c.event_at < CAST('2026-11-15' AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND 1 = 0
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  month

author: self
question: What is realized revenue by delivery address region?
sql:
SELECT
  a.region,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN NOT s.delivered_at IS NULL
      THEN s.net_amount - COALESCE(s.refund_amount, 0)
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS realized_revenue
FROM sales AS s
JOIN customer_addresses AS a
  ON s.address_id = a.address_id
WHERE
  s.line_type = 'Sale'
  AND s.placed_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND s.placed_at < CAST('2026-11-15' AS TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY
  a.region
ORDER BY
  realized_revenue DESC

author: self
question: How many support contacts were about payments, including password-reset style login problems?
sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT contact_id) AS matching_contacts
FROM support_contacts
WHERE
  issue_category = 'Payments'
  AND contact_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND contact_at < CAST('2026-11-15' AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND (
    REGEXP_MATCHES(
      transcript_text,
      '(?i)\b(payment|paying|transaction|upi|card|checkout|refund|charge|debit)\b[^.\n]{0,60}\b(fail(ed|ure|s)?|declined|rejected|unsuccessful|stuck|pending|problem|issue|trouble|error|not received|not working|does not work|doesn''t work|did not (arrive|go through)|didn''t (arrive|go through)|charged twice|debited twice|deducted twice)\b|\b(failed|declined|rejected|problem|issue|trouble|error|duplicate|unauthorized|incorrect)\b[^.\n]{0,60}\b(payment|transaction|upi|card|checkout|refund|charge|debit)\b|\b(can''t|cannot|couldn''t|could not|unable to)\s+(pay|check out|checkout)\b'
    )
    OR REGEXP_MATCHES(
      transcript_text,
      '(?i)\b(password|password reset|reset link)\b[^.\n]{0,60}\b(fail(ed|s)?|problem|issue|trouble|error|incorrect|wrong|not working|does not work|doesn''t work|not received|expired|invalid)\b|\b(forgot|forgotten|lost)\s+(my |the )?password\b|\b(can''t|cannot|couldn''t|could not|unable to)\s+(reset|change)\s+(my |the )?password\b|\b(can''t|cannot|couldn''t|could not|unable to)\s+(log in|login|sign in)\b|\blocked out of (my |the )?account\b'
    )
  )
  AND NOT REGEXP_MATCHES(
    transcript_text,
    '(?i)\b(but|however)\s+(it |that |the payment |the link )?(now works|works now|is now working|is working now|has been resolved|is resolved)\b|\b(payment|refund|password|reset link|login|issue|problem)\b[^.\n]{0,60}\b(is now resolved|has been resolved|now works|works now)\b|\b(no|without)\s+(payment |login |password )?(problems?|issues?|trouble)\b|\b(payment|login|password)\b[^.\n]{0,30}\b(no problems?|no issues?)\b'
  )
warnings: Reviewer concern: The exclusion of transcripts saying a problem was resolved or now works removes contacts that were nevertheless about a payment or login problem; the plan does not exclude resolved problems.

Reviewer concern: The keyword patterns miss valid descriptions, such as a reset link that never arrived or a payment that was deducted without words like 'failed' or 'issue'. Use a validated transcript classification method that covers such descriptions rather than relying on these narrow patterns.

author: self
question: What share of sessions come from Mobile Web versus the apps?
sql:
WITH period_events AS (
  SELECT
    c.session_id,
    c.device
  FROM clickstream AS c
  WHERE
    c.event_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND c.event_at < CAST('2026-11-15' AS TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  device,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)
    FROM period_events
  ) AS all_device_sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF((
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)
    FROM period_events
  ), 0) AS session_share
FROM period_events
WHERE
  device IN ('Mobile Web', 'Android App', 'iOS App')
GROUP BY
  device
ORDER BY
  sessions DESC

question: What is the RTO rate by the city tier of the delivery address?
sql:
SELECT
  a.city_tier,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT s.rto_at IS NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT s.shipped_at IS NULL), 0) AS rto_rate,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT s.rto_at IS NULL) AS rto_lines,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT s.shipped_at IS NULL) AS shipped_lines
FROM sales AS s
JOIN customer_addresses AS a
  ON s.address_id = a.address_id
WHERE
  s.line_type = 'Sale'
  AND s.placed_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND s.placed_at < CAST('2026-11-15' AS TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY
  a.city_tier
ORDER BY
  rto_rate DESC

question: What is the average order value on mobile web compared with desktop?
sql:
SELECT
  s.device AS device,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN s.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN s.order_id END), 0) AS aov,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN s.order_id END) AS qualifying_orders
FROM sales AS s
WHERE
  s.line_type = 'Sale'
  AND s.device IN ('Mobile Web', 'Desktop Web')
  AND s.placed_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND s.placed_at < CAST('2026-11-15' AS TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY
  s.device
ORDER BY
  aov DESC

author: self
question: Which pincode-level delivery regions have the most late deliveries? Region level is fine.
sql:
SELECT
  a.region,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    CAST(s.delivered_at AS DATE) > CAST(s.promised_delivery_date AS DATE)) AS late_delivered_lines,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT s.delivered_at IS NULL) AS delivered_lines,
  (
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      CAST(s.delivered_at AS DATE) > CAST(s.promised_delivery_date AS DATE))
  ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT s.delivered_at IS NULL), 0) AS late_delivery_rate
FROM sales AS s
JOIN customer_addresses AS a
  ON s.address_id = a.address_id
WHERE
  s.line_type = 'Sale'
  AND s.delivered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND s.delivered_at < CAST('2026-11-15' AS TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY
  a.region
ORDER BY
  late_delivered_lines DESC,
  a.region
LIMIT 10

author: self
question: How many support tickets came in by phone, chat and email?
sql:
WITH tk AS (
  SELECT
    ticket_id,
    MIN(contact_at) AS opened_at,
    ARG_MIN(channel, contact_at) AS channel,
    ARG_MIN(issue_category, contact_at) AS issue_category,
    ARG_MAX(resolution_status, contact_at) AS resolution_status,
    COUNT(*) AS contacts
  FROM support_contacts
  GROUP BY
    ticket_id
)
SELECT
  channel,
  COUNT(*) AS support_tickets
FROM tk
WHERE
  channel IN ('phone', 'chat', 'email')
  AND opened_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND opened_at < CAST('2026-11-15' AS TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY
  channel
ORDER BY
  support_tickets DESC

author: self
question: Send me the street and flat number for each high-value shopper.
sql:
WITH customer_sales AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN s.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales
  FROM sales AS s
  WHERE
    s.line_type = 'Sale'
    AND s.placed_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND s.placed_at < CAST('2026-11-15' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND NOT s.customer_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    s.customer_id
  HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN s.net_amount ELSE 0 END) >= 50000
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS high_value_shoppers,
  COALESCE(SUM(net_sales), 0) AS total_net_sales
FROM customer_sales
